verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֣א מוּעָף֮ לַאֲשֶׁ֣ר מוּצָ֣ק לָהּ֒ כָּעֵ֣ת הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן הֵקַ֞ל אַ֤רְצָה זְבֻלוּן֙ וְאַ֣רְצָה נַפְתָּלִ֔י וְהָאַחֲר֖וֹן הִכְבִּ֑יד דֶּ֤רֶךְ הַיָּם֙ עֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן גְּלִ֖יל הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō mū·‘āp̄ la·’ă·šer mū·ṣāq lāh kā·‘êṯ hā·ri·šō·wn hê·qal ’ar·ṣāh zə·ḇu·lūn wə·’ar·ṣāh nap̄·tā·lî wə·hā·’a·ḥă·rō·wn hiḵ·bîḏ de·reḵ hay·yām ‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên gə·lîl hag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: Nevertheless there will be no more gloom for those in distress In the past . . . He humbled the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali but in the future He will honor the Way of the Sea beyond the Jordan Galilee of the nations
verses.literalPt: MAS a terra, que foi angustiada, não será entenebrecida; envileceu nos primeiros tempos, a terra de Zebulom, e a terra de Naftali; mas nos últimos tempos a enobreceu junto ao caminho do mar, além do Jordão, na Galiléia das nações.

verses.original: הָעָם֙ הַהֹלְכִ֣ים בַּחֹ֔שֶׁךְ רָא֖וּ א֣וֹר גָּד֑וֹל יֹשְׁבֵי֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ צַלְמָ֔וֶת א֖וֹר נָגַ֥הּ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hā·‘ām ha·hō·lə·ḵîm ba·ḥō·šeḵ rā·’ū ’ō·wr gā·ḏō·wl yō·šə·ḇê bə·’e·reṣ ṣal·mā·weṯ ’ō·wr nā·ḡah ‘ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: The people walking in darkness have seen a great light on those living in the land of the shadow of death a light has dawned
verses.literalPt: O povo que andava em trevas, viu uma grande luz, e sobre os que habitavam na região da sombra da morte resplandeceu a luz.

verses.original: הִרְבִּ֣יתָ הַגּ֔וֹי לֹא הִגְדַּ֣לְתָּ הַשִּׂמְחָ֑ה שָׂמְח֤וּ לְפָנֶ֙יךָ֙ כְּשִׂמְחַ֣ת בַּקָּצִ֔יר כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יָגִ֖ילוּ בְּחַלְּקָ֥ם שָׁלָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hir·bî·ṯā hag·gō·w lō hiḡ·dal·tā haś·śim·ḥāh śā·mə·ḥū lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā kə·śim·ḥaṯ baq·qā·ṣîr ka·’ă·šer yā·ḡî·lū bə·ḥal·lə·qām šā·lāl
verses.literal: You have enlarged the nation . . . and increased its joy The people rejoice before You as they rejoice at harvest time as men rejoice in dividing the plunder
verses.literalPt: Tu multiplicaste a nação, a alegria lhe aumentaste; todos se alegrarão perante ti, como se alegram na ceifa, e como exultam quando se repartem os despojos.

verses.original: כִּ֣י׀ אֶת־ עֹ֣ל סֻבֳּל֗וֹ וְאֵת֙ מַטֵּ֣ה שִׁכְמ֔וֹ שֵׁ֖בֶט הַנֹּגֵ֣שׂ בּ֑וֹ הַחִתֹּ֖תָ כְּי֥וֹם מִדְיָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’eṯ- ‘ōl sub·bo·lōw wə·’êṯ maṭ·ṭêh šiḵ·mōw šê·ḇeṭ han·nō·ḡêś bōw ha·ḥit·tō·ṯā kə·yō·wm miḏ·yān
verses.literal: For as in the day of Midian You have shattered the yoke of their burden the bar across their shoulders and the rod of their oppressor . . .
verses.literalPt: Porque tu quebraste o jugo da sua carga, e o bordão do seu ombro, e a vara do seu opressor, como no dia dos midianitas.

verses.original: כִּ֤י כָל־ סְאוֹן֙ סֹאֵ֣ן בְּרַ֔עַשׁ וְשִׂמְלָ֖ה מְגוֹלָלָ֣ה בְדָמִ֑ים וְהָיְתָ֥ה לִשְׂרֵפָ֖ה מַאֲכֹ֥לֶת אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵāl sə·’ō·wn sō·’ên bə·ra·‘aš wə·śim·lāh mə·ḡō·w·lā·lāh ḇə·ḏā·mîm wə·hā·yə·ṯāh liś·rê·p̄āh ma·’ă·ḵō·leṯ ’êš
verses.literal: For every trampling boot of battle and every garment rolled in blood will be burned as fuel for the fire
verses.literalPt: Porque todo calçado que levava o guerreiro no tumulto da batalha, e todo o manto revolvido em sangue, serão queimados, servindo de combustível ao fogo.

verses.original: כִּי־ יֶ֣לֶד יֻלַּד־ לָ֗נוּ בֵּ֚ן נִתַּן־ לָ֔נוּ וַתְּהִ֥י הַמִּשְׂרָ֖ה עַל־ שִׁכְמ֑וֹ וַיִּקְרָ֨א שְׁמ֜וֹ פֶּ֠לֶא יוֹעֵץ֙ אֵ֣ל גִּבּ֔וֹר אֲבִיעַ֖ד שַׂר־ שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ye·leḏ yul·laḏ- lā·nū bên nit·tan- lā·nū wat·tə·hî ham·miś·rāh ‘al- šiḵ·mōw way·yiq·rā šə·mōw pe·le yō·w·‘êṣ ’êl gib·bō·wr ’ă·ḇî·‘aḏ śar- šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: For unto us a child is born unto us a son is given and the government will be upon His shoulders And He will be called . . . Wonderful Counselor Mighty God Everlasting Father Prince of Peace
verses.literalPt: Porque um menino nos nasceu, um filho se nos deu, e o principado está sobre os seus ombros, e se chamará o seu nome: Maravilhoso, Conselheiro, Deus Forte, Pai da Eternidade, Príncipe da Paz.

verses.original: לְםַרְבֵּה הַמִּשְׂרָ֜ה וּלְשָׁל֣וֹם אֵֽין־ קֵ֗ץ עַל־ כִּסֵּ֤א דָוִד֙ וְעַל־ מַמְלַכְתּ֔וֹ לְהָכִ֤ין אֹתָהּ֙ וּֽלְסַעֲדָ֔הּ בְּמִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּבִצְדָקָ֑ה מֵעַתָּה֙ וְעַד־ עוֹלָ֔ם קִנְאַ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה־ זֹּֽאת׃ס
verses.transliteration: lə·mar·bēh ham·miś·rāh ū·lə·šā·lō·wm ’ên- qêṣ ‘al- kis·sê ḏā·wiḏ wə·‘al- mam·laḵ·tōw lə·hā·ḵîn ’ō·ṯāh ū·lə·sa·‘ă·ḏāh bə·miš·pāṭ ū·ḇiṣ·ḏā·qāh mê·‘at·tāh wə·‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām qin·’aṯ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ta·‘ă·śeh- zōṯ
verses.literal: Of the increase of His government and peace there will be no end He will reign on the throne of David and over his kingdom to establish and sustain it with justice and righteousness from that time and forevermore . . . The zeal of the LORD of Hosts will accomplish this
verses.literalPt: Do aumento deste principado e da paz não haverá fim, sobre o trono de Davi e no seu reino, para o firmar e o fortificar com juízo e com justiça, desde agora e para sempre; o zelo do SENHOR dos Exércitos fará isto.

verses.original: דָּבָ֛ר שָׁלַ֥ח אֲדֹנָ֖י בְּיַעֲקֹ֑ב וְנָפַ֖ל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: dā·ḇār šā·laḥ ’ă·ḏō·nāy bə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·nā·p̄al bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: The Lord has sent a message against Jacob and it has fallen upon Israel
verses.literalPt: O Senhor enviou uma palavra a Jacó, e ela caiu em Israel.

verses.original: וְיָדְעוּ֙ הָעָ֣ם כֻּלּ֔וֹ אֶפְרַ֖יִם וְיוֹשֵׁ֣ב שֹׁמְר֑וֹן בְּגַאֲוָ֛ה וּבְגֹ֥דֶל לֵבָ֖ב לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū hā·‘ām kul·lōw ’ep̄·ra·yim wə·yō·wō·šêḇ šō·mə·rō·wn bə·ḡa·’ă·wāh ū·ḇə·ḡō·ḏel lê·ḇāḇ lê·mōr
verses.literal: All the people will know it Ephraim and the dwellers of Samaria With pride and arrogance of heart they will say
verses.literalPt: E todo este povo o saberá, Efraim e os moradores de Samaria, que em soberba e altivez de coração, dizem:

verses.original: לְבֵנִ֥ים נָפָ֖לוּ וְגָזִ֣ית נִבְנֶ֑ה שִׁקְמִ֣ים גֻּדָּ֔עוּ וַאֲרָזִ֖ים נַחֲלִֽיף׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḇê·nîm nā·p̄ā·lū wə·ḡā·zîṯ niḇ·neh šiq·mîm gud·dā·‘ū wa·’ă·rā·zîm na·ḥă·lîp̄
verses.literal: The bricks have fallen but we will rebuild with finished stone the sycamores have been felled but we will replace them with cedars
verses.literalPt: Os tijolos caíram, mas com cantaria tornaremos a edificar; cortaram-se os sicômoros, mas em cedros as mudaremos.

verses.original: וַיְשַׂגֵּ֧ב יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ צָרֵ֥י רְצִ֖ין עָלָ֑יו וְאֶת־ אֹיְבָ֖יו יְסַכְסֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·śag·gêḇ Yah·weh ’eṯ- ṣā·rê rə·ṣîn ‘ā·lāw wə·’eṯ- ’ō·yə·ḇāw yə·saḵ·sêḵ
verses.literal: The LORD has raised up the foes of Rezin against him and joined his enemies together
verses.literalPt: Portanto o SENHOR suscitará, contra ele, os adversários de Rezim, e juntará os seus inimigos.

verses.original: אֲרָ֣ם מִקֶּ֗דֶם וּפְלִשְׁתִּים֙ מֵֽאָח֔וֹר וַיֹּאכְל֥וּ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּכָל־ פֶּ֑ה בְּכָל־ זֹאת֙ לֹא־ שָׁ֣ב אַפּ֔וֹ וְע֖וֹד יָד֥וֹ נְטוּיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·rām miq·qe·ḏem ū·p̄ə·liš·tîm mê·’ā·ḥō·wr way·yō·ḵə·lū ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl bə·ḵāl peh bə·ḵāl zōṯ lō- šāḇ ’ap·pōw wə·‘ō·wḏ yā·ḏōw nə·ṭū·yāh
verses.literal: Aram from the east and Philistia from the west have devoured Israel with open mouths Despite all this His anger is not turned away His hand is still upraised
verses.literalPt: Pela frente virão os sírios, e por detrás os filisteus, e devorarão a Israel à boca escancarada; e nem com tudo isto cessou a sua ira, mas ainda está estendida a sua mão.

verses.original: וְהָעָ֥ם לֹא־ שָׁ֖ב עַד־ הַמַּכֵּ֑הוּ וְאֶת־ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֹ֥א דָרָֽשׁוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·‘ām lō- šāḇ ‘aḏ- ham·mak·kê·hū wə·’eṯ- Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ lō ḏā·rā·šū
verses.literal: But the people did not return to Him who struck them they did not seek the LORD of Hosts
verses.literalPt: Todavia este povo não se voltou para quem o feria, nem buscou ao SENHOR dos Exércitos.

verses.original: וַיַּכְרֵ֨ת יְהוָ֜ה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֗ל רֹ֧אשׁ וְזָנָ֛ב כִּפָּ֥ה וְאַגְמ֖וֹן י֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ·rêṯ Yah·weh mî·yiś·rā·’êl rōš wə·zā·nāḇ kip·pāh wə·’aḡ·mō·wn yō·wm ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: So the LORD will cut off Israel’s head and tail both palm branch and reed in a single day
verses.literalPt: Assim o SENHOR cortará de Israel a cabeça e a cauda, o ramo e o junco, num mesmo dia

verses.original: זָקֵ֥ן וּנְשׂוּא־ פָנִ֖ים ה֣וּא הָרֹ֑אשׁ וְנָבִ֥יא מֽוֹרֶה־ שֶּׁ֖קֶר ה֥וּא הַזָּנָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: zā·qên ū·nə·śū- p̄ā·nîm hū hā·rōš wə·nā·ḇî mō·w·reh- še·qer hū haz·zā·nāḇ
verses.literal: The head is the elder and honorable man and the tail is the prophet who teaches lies
verses.literalPt: (O ancião e o homem de respeito é a cabeça; e o profeta que ensina a falsidade é a cauda).

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְי֛וּ מְאַשְּׁרֵ֥י הָֽעָם־ הַזֶּ֖ה מַתְעִ֑ים וּמְאֻשָּׁרָ֖יו מְבֻלָּעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū mə·’aš·šə·rê hā·‘ām- haz·zeh maṯ·‘îm ū·mə·’uš·šā·rāw mə·ḇul·lā·‘îm
verses.literal: For those who guide this people . . . mislead them and those they mislead are swallowed up
verses.literalPt: Porque os guias deste povo são enganadores, e os que por eles são guiados são destruídos.

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֨ן עַל־ בַּחוּרָ֜יו לֹֽא־ יִשְׂמַ֣ח׀ אֲדֹנָ֗י וְאֶת־ יְתֹמָ֤יו וְאֶת־ אַלְמְנֹתָיו֙ לֹ֣א יְרַחֵ֔ם כִּ֤י כֻלּוֹ֙ חָנֵ֣ף וּמֵרַ֔ע וְכָל־ פֶּ֖ה דֹּבֵ֣ר נְבָלָ֑ה בְּכָל־ זֹאת֙ לֹא־ שָׁ֣ב אַפּ֔וֹ וְע֖וֹד יָד֥וֹ נְטוּיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên ‘al- ba·ḥū·rāw lō- yiś·maḥ ’ă·ḏō·nāy wə·’eṯ- yə·ṯō·māw wə·’eṯ- ’al·mə·nō·ṯāw lō yə·ra·ḥêm kî ḵul·lōw ḥā·nêp̄ ū·mê·ra‘ wə·ḵāl peh dō·ḇêr nə·ḇā·lāh bə·ḵāl zōṯ lō- šāḇ ’ap·pōw wə·‘ō·wḏ yā·ḏōw nə·ṭū·yāh
verses.literal: Therefore . . . the Lord takes no pleasure in their young men He has no compassion on their fatherless and widows For every one of them is godless and wicked and every mouth speaks folly Despite all this His anger is not turned away His hand is still upraised
verses.literalPt: Por isso o Senhor não se regozija nos seus jovens, e não se compadecerá dos seus órfãos e das suas viúvas, porque todos eles são hipócritas e malfazejos, e toda a boca profere doidices; e nem com tudo isto cessou a sua ira, mas ainda está estendida a sua mão.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ בָעֲרָ֤ה כָאֵשׁ֙ רִשְׁעָ֔ה שָׁמִ֥יר וָשַׁ֖יִת תֹּאכֵ֑ל וַתִּצַּת֙ בְּסִֽבְכֵ֣י הַיַּ֔עַר וַיִּֽתְאַבְּכ֖וּ גֵּא֥וּת עָשָֽׁן׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḇā·‘ă·rāh ḵā·’êš riš·‘āh šā·mîr wā·ša·yiṯ tō·ḵêl wat·tiṣ·ṣaṯ bə·siḇ·ḵê hay·ya·‘ar way·yiṯ·’ab·bə·ḵū gê·’ūṯ ‘ā·šān
verses.literal: For wickedness burns like a fire that consumes the thorns and briers and kindles the forest thickets which roll upward in billows of smoke
verses.literalPt: Porque a impiedade lavra como um fogo, ela devora as sarças e os espinheiros; e ela se ateará no emaranhado da floresta; e subirão em espessas nuvens de fumaça.

verses.original: בְּעֶבְרַ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת נֶעְתַּ֣ם אָ֑רֶץ וַיְהִ֤י הָעָם֙ כְּמַאֲכֹ֣לֶת אֵ֔שׁ אִ֥ישׁ אֶל־ אָחִ֖יו לֹ֥א יַחְמֹֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·‘eḇ·raṯ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ne‘·tam ’ā·reṣ way·hî hā·‘ām kə·ma·’ă·ḵō·leṯ ’êš ’îš ’el- ’ā·ḥîw lō yaḥ·mō·lū
verses.literal: By the wrath of the LORD of Hosts the land is scorched and the people are fuel for the fire No man even spares . . . his brother
verses.literalPt: Por causa da ira do SENHOR dos Exércitos a terra se escurecerá, e será o povo como combustível para o fogo; ninguém poupará ao seu irmão.

verses.original: וַיִּגְזֹ֤ר עַל־ יָמִין֙ וְרָעֵ֔ב וַיֹּ֥אכַל עַל־ שְׂמֹ֖אול וְלֹ֣א שָׂבֵ֑עוּ אִ֥ישׁ בְּשַׂר־ זְרֹע֖וֹ יֹאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḡ·zōr ‘al- yā·mîn wə·rā·‘êḇ way·yō·ḵal ‘al- śə·mō·wl wə·lō śā·ḇê·‘ū ’îš bə·śar- zə·rō·‘ōw yō·ḵê·lū
verses.literal: They carve out what is on the right but they are still hungry they eat what is on the left but they are still not satisfied Each one devours the flesh of his own offspring
verses.literalPt: Se colher à direita, ainda terá fome, e se comer à esquerda, ainda não se fartará; cada um comerá a carne de seu braço.

verses.original: מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה אֶת־ אֶפְרַ֗יִם וְאֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ אֶת־ מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה יַחְדָּ֥ו הֵ֖מָּה עַל־ יְהוּדָ֑ה בְּכָל־ זֹאת֙ לֹא־ שָׁ֣ב אַפּ֔וֹ וְע֖וֹד יָד֥וֹ נְטוּיָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: mə·naš·šeh ’eṯ- ’ep̄·ra·yim wə·’ep̄·ra·yim ’eṯ- mə·naš·šeh yaḥ·dāw hêm·māh ‘al- yə·hū·ḏāh bə·ḵāl zōṯ lō- šāḇ ’ap·pōw wə·‘ō·wḏ yā·ḏōw nə·ṭū·yāh
verses.literal: Manasseh devours Ephraim and Ephraim Manasseh together . . . they turn against Judah Despite all this His anger is not turned away His hand is still upraised
verses.literalPt: Manassés a Efraim, e Efraim a Manassés, e ambos serão contra Judá. Com tudo isto não cessou a sua ira, mas ainda está estendida a sua mão.
